units.source_text: 自此以后，柏木天天向小侍从催问有否机会。

en.t: From then on, Kashiwagi pressed Kojujo every day, asking whether there might be an opportunity.

units.source_text: 小侍从不胜其烦，终于替他找到了一个机会，来向他通报。

en.t: Kojujo, unable to bear his persistence, finally found an opportunity for him and came to tell him.

units.source_text: 柏木大喜，连忙改装易服，悄悄地混进六条院来。

en.t: Kashiwagi was overjoyed, quickly changed his appearance and clothes, and quietly slipped into the Rokujo estate.

units.source_text: 柏木自己也知道此事实在很不应该，所以他做梦也不曾想到：

en.t: Kashiwagi himself knew very well that this was terribly improper, so he never dreamed that

units.source_text: 接近之后会引起越轨行为，反而增添日后的烦恼。

en.t: after coming close to her, it would lead to a transgression and instead add to his troubles afterward.

units.source_text: 他只是为了七年前那个春天的傍晚从帘底隐约窥见了三公主的衣襟之后，

en.t: It was only because, on that spring evening seven years before, he had faintly glimpsed the Third Princess's sleeve beneath the curtain, and afterward

units.source_text: 心头永远浮现着她的芳姿，常觉不能餍足，

en.t: her lovely figure was forever appearing in his heart, and he always felt unsatisfied.

units.source_text: 总想稍稍接近，以便细看一看，并把心事向她诉说，

en.t: He constantly wished to draw a little closer, so that he might look at her carefully and tell her what was in his heart.

units.source_text: 也许可以得到她一句答语，对他表示可怜。

en.t: Perhaps he might receive even a single reply from her, showing that she felt pity for him.
